en.title: At Calvary
en.author: William R. Newell
stanzas:
[C]Years I spent in vanity and pride,
[G7]Caring not my Lord was [C]crucified,
[C]Knowing not it was for me He died
On [F]Cal[G7]va[C]ry.

By God's Word at last my sin I learned;
Then I trembled at the law I'd spurned,
Till my guilty soul imploring turned
To Calvary.

Now I've giv'n to Jesus everything,
Now I gladly own Him as my King,
Now my raptured soul can only sing
Of Calvary!

Oh, the love that drew salvation's plan!
Oh, the grace that brought it down to man!
Oh, the mighty gulf that God did span
At Calvary!

notes: Text from Timeless Truths, which cites hymnary. Hymnary's representative text (Our Great Redeemer's Praise #579) agrees word for word apart from 'ev'rything' for 'everything' and 'O the' for 'Oh, the' in stanza 4; TT kept. Tune CALVARY (Towner, 1895; hymnary's record is dated 1887 but the text is 1895), meter 9.9.9.4 with refrain. Key C: hymnary's instances run 45 C to 2 B-flat and TT prints C, already a guitar key. Chords derived from the Timeless Truths MusicXML score by reading the four-part chord on every beat. The stanza sits on I with a ii7 and a V7sus4 neighbour over the tonic pedal that were dropped, V7 for 'Caring not my Lord was', and the IV6-V7-I cadence on 'Cal-va-ry'. Refrain: IV with its minor-iv colouring under 'Mercy there was great' dropped, the 6/4 under 'grace' written as the C it is, V7 through 'Pardon there was multiplied', and the same cadence. Stanza 3 'giv'n' is TT's elision and matches the score.
